'''1998 Toola Regional (Malmö)''' was a Star Wars CCG regional on 1998. [[Martin Akesson]] won it. It is known from Martin Akesson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1274">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-27-scandinavian-regional-98d1274/ scandinavian-regional-98], DeckTech (Martin "Mart" Akesson, 27 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-27-scandinavian-regional-98d1274/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 1998
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace]]
* '''Players:''' 43
* '''Winner:''' [[Martin Akesson]]
